author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
In 1947, a single cigarette on the SS Grandcamp triggered a catastrophic ammonium nitrate explosion that killed 581 people and devastated Texas City. The blast produced a fireball 600 meters high, equivalent to a tenth of the Hiroshima bomb’s force, and reshaped industrial safety standards forever.
